{text}

{tags}
#
# """ def compose_post_html(poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑safe HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str Name of the user who posted. headline : str Title/headline of the post. text : str Main content/body of the post. hashtags : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The HTML string ready to be rendered. All user supplied content is escaped to prevent cross‑site scripting attacks. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required arguments are missing or empty. "), tags=tags_html ) except NameError: raise RuntimeError("USER_POST_FORMAT is not defined in the current context") return formatted
